verdict.rationale: MailerSend ships a first-party hosted MCP server at mcp.mailersend.com. It lets AI assistants like Claude or Gemini operate the product in natural language, covering sending email and SMS and managing domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities and users. The natural-language layer comes from the connected AI client, and the only evidence is vendor docs. Missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP tools work reliably, and documentation of tool-level limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This server enables AI assistants to send emails and SMS, manage domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities, users, and many other things through standardized MCP tools.
Usually, you would just add `https://mcp.mailersend.com/mcp` as a remote MCP address in any tooling that you are working with.
Connect MailerSend directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini.
